helpful: The provisioned petition text: its vehicle section explicitly ties the ask to the companion petition, which reframed the whole forecast.
The sal-v4 segment band table with bracketed reached rates gave a clean pooled anchor.
The CourtListener dockets endpoint resolved the companion docket id even where search returned nothing; the supremecourt.gov docket page then supplied the companion's entries.
gaps: CourtListener carries no docket entries for SCOTUS dockets, so companion-case status had to come from the web; a provisioned 'related dockets' file (companions named in the petition or sharing amicus filings) with their current entries would save several retrieval calls.

The frozen distribution_count treats a pre-consideration reschedule as a distribution; a separate true-relist count (or the raw entry list with kinds) in context.json would let the relist cut be read directly.
The corpus query has no caption or free-text filter for SCOTUS rows, so it cannot find a named companion case.
notes: Roughly 14 retrieval calls (5 MCP, 6 web, 3 corpus), within the advisory budget. The SG's brief in opposition in the companion was characterized from a trade-press summary, not read directly.
